basic_details.job_title: ECHS Barnala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Clerk, Driver and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: OIC Polyclinic, Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Clerk, Driver, Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Peon
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

qualification.details: The notice states the minimum qualification against each post as follows: | Preference will be given to ex-servicemen. Only candidates who meet the qualitative requirement should apply. For the full eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

selection_process: Selection is by interview at Air Force Station Barnala on 25 November 2026. Candidates must reach the venue by 0900 Hrs
and the interview runs between 1000 Hrs and 1400 Hrs. No TA/DA will be paid for attending.
Bring these originals to the interview:
10+2 and Graduation/post-graduation/diploma/course Work experience certificates Discharge book
PPO and service records (ex-servicemen) Passport size colour photographs
how_to_apply: Download the application format and the terms and conditions from www.echs.gov.in.
Fill in the application in the required format.
Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials for your educational qualifications and work experience.
Submit the application in duplicate to the OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell), Barnala, by 20 November 2026.
Applications received after cease-work (1430 hrs) on 20 November 2026 will not be accepted.
For more details, contact Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Barnala on 01679-289641 or at [email protected]. You can also ask at ECHS Polyclinic Barnala.

content_sections.heading: About ECHS Barnala
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) works under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This notice comes from its Station HQ (ECHS Cell) at Barnala, and the posts are at the ECHS Polyclinic Barnala, which needs medical, para-medical and non-medical staff.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview at Air Force Station Barnala on 25 November 2026. Candidates must reach the venue by 0900 Hrs, and the interview runs between 1000 Hrs and 1400 Hrs. No TA/DA will be paid for attending. Bring these originals to the interview: Certificates, mark sheets and degrees of 10th/Matric, 10+2 and Graduation/post-graduation/diploma/course Work experience certificates Discharge book, PPO and service records (ex-servicemen) Passport size colour photographs

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is on a contractual basis at ECHS Polyclinic Barnala. Ex-servicemen (ESMs) are engaged for one year. Civilian candidates are engaged for 11 months. The engagement may run until the candidate reaches the maximum age. It depends on the candidate's performance and other conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies has ECHS Barnala announced?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies in total: 2 for Medical Officer and 1 each for OIC Polyclinic, Pharmacist, Clerk, Driver, Female Attendant, Safaiwala and Peon.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Your application must reach the OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell), Barnala by 20 November 2026, before cease-work at 1430 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Medical Officer pays a fixed remuneration of Rs. 95,000/-, the same as OIC Polyclinic.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a Graduate or hold the Class I clerical trade of the Armed Forces. The fixed remuneration is Rs. 29,200/-.

faq.question: Q5. Can a 10+2 candidate apply for Pharmacist?
faq.answer: Yes. You need 10+2 with the science stream and an approved diploma in pharmacy from an institute recognised by the Pharmacy Council of India. M Pharma or B Pharma holders can also apply.

faq.question: Q6. How many copies of the application should be sent?
faq.answer: Submit the application in duplicate, with self-attested photocopies of your educational and work experience testimonials.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: Report at Air Force Station Barnala at 0900 Hrs on 25 November 2026. The interview runs from 1000 Hrs to 1400 Hrs.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: Ex-servicemen are engaged for one year and civilian candidates for 11 months, subject to performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.
